text: 77 RS UNDERGROUND FOREST The River of the Depths con- nects the fourth and fifth lev- els of Undermountain, skirt- ing the edges of vast caverns filled with trees, shrubs, birds, other animals, and sunlight. An entire forest, as real as any found on the surface, waits to be explored, but an archdruid protects it. And explorers traveling downriver have seen a huge green dragon as well, perched on a tower near a bridge that spans the river. <5 =
